notes:
Summary: R&D + Product (clinical AI) evaluated Redwood for chat/summarization POC. Started Nov 2025. Strong initial interest: VPC, KV cache, quantization suggestions were a hit. POC (Dec-Jan) ran on small dataset (de-identified patient notes). Short fragments below from AE/SE/POC owner notes.

Dec 05 - Intro call (Samira): product team excited about batching suggestions and cost modeling. Asked about HIPAA/KMS flow.
Dec 12 - SE deep-dive (Diego): ran latency tests, Redwood runtime gave 120ms median on 8k token context for core flows. Discussed canary rollouts, audit logs.
Dec 20 - Security kickoff: requested SOC2 report, KMS integration diagram, encryption-at-rest details. Provided redacted docs (drive link).
Jan 08 - POC kickoff: ingest pipeline, sample prompts, evaluation set. POC acceptance criteria: <200ms p50, 95% uptime for test window, data residency in US.
Jan 22 - Mid-POC sync: pricing sticker shock for committed capacity; asked about ability to start hosted and move to Dedicated.
Feb 03 - Exec call: CFO and VP Eng present. Quote reviewed. CFO: "we can start with direct vendor credits to move faster."
Feb 10 - Final demo + security signoff attempt. Security: preference for vendor with mature, global brand footprint; they flagged vendor onboarding risk.
Feb 11 - Decision: opted for direct OpenAI + Anthropic combo. Reasons stated on call: simplicity of direct API, consolidated invoicing with existing vendor relationships, perception of lower procurement friction, ability to use free/enterprise credits to accelerate rollout.

What went wrong / lessons:
- No internal champion post-org-reorg (head of ML moved teams). Momentum faded.
- Procurement/security prioritized existing vendor brand and simplicity over feature parity.
- Budget timing: CFO indicated a Q1 freeze but preferred to route via known suppliers to expedite immediate PoC.
- We did well technically but lost on perceived operational friction and name recognition. SE gave a strong technical rebuttal but decision held.

Follow-ups: capture POC artifacts, add to competitive loss playbook (notes on security objections and messaging), re-target if vendor contract windows open or internal champion returns.
lost_reason: Closed-lost: procurement/security & execs chose direct OpenAI/Anthropic APIs. Cited simplicity, brand trust, existing vendor relationships and immediate credits/incentives. No internal champion after reorg and Q1 budget constraints.
